A review report, never an import file. Nothing connects to your store or changes the original files. A missing SKU or blank value does not mean delete or set to zero.

A clear boundary around your data

Local processing. File contents are read in this tab. No accounts, file uploads to a server, analytics, or store access.

Explicit matching. One SKU column and one numeric value column from each file. Duplicates are held for review. No guessed matches.

CSV only for this release. UTF-8 files, up to 5 MB, 10,000 rows, and 200 columns each. Fields: 65,536 characters; numeric values: 100 characters. Plain decimals; no currency symbols or thousands separators.

Built with AI assistance by Logan Baird. Independent tool; not affiliated with Shopify.

Free to use. Review the results before making any catalog changes.

Two files. One explicit review.

  1. Export a fresh catalog and keep your original supplier file.
  2. Choose the identifier and numeric value columns yourself. Set each file’s decimal format.
  3. Compare, inspect exceptions, and download the review report.

Identifiers are text. For example, 0007 and 7 are different SKUs. Case is significant. Optional trimming removes only spaces at the edges.

Record numbers include the header as record 1. A quoted multiline field is one record. Reports escape formula-like text for safer spreadsheet viewing and are not designed for re-import.

Your files stay in memory until you clear them or close this page. No data is saved between visits.

Your review report

The report includes all compared rows. If your browser blocks downloads, copy this CSV into a UTF-8 text file named catalog-change-review.csv. This is a review report, not an import file.
